headline: Revenue and profit growth accelerate across the board
summary_short: Landstar's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose to $1,432.3 million, up 22.3% q/q and 18.2% y/y, while diluted EPS climbed to $1.44, up 24.1% q/q and 20.0% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue rose to $1,432.3M (+22.3% q/q, +18.2% y/y). Gross profit grew to $189.0M (+17.0% q/q, +19.4% y/y). Operating income rose to $63.5M (+19.3% q/q, +12.9% y/y), while EBITDA reached $73.9M (+21.5% q/q, +14.3% y/y). Net income climbed to $49.0M (+24.1% q/q, +16.8% y/y) and diluted EPS rose to $1.44 (+24.1% q/q, +20.0% y/y).
